def solve():
    # Read input
    line = input().strip()
    # Split into parts
    parts = line.split(',')
    # Extract tokens
    tokens = parts[0].split()
    # Extract first and last tokens
    first = tokens[0]
    last = tokens[-1]
    # Generate the chain
    chain = []
    current = first

        chain.append(current)
        current = tokens[i+1]
    # Add the last token
    chain.append(last)
